blurb: Nestled in the vibrant community of Ramsay/Inglewood in Calgary, Moveology is a barre, Pilates, and fitness studio that celebrates the joy of movement. We aim to make fitness fun and the highlight of your day. With an emphasis on mindful form, we provide options and modifications, helping you feel stronger, more energized, and confident in your movement.
